dmytro.name: Dmytro
dmytro.persona_brief:
You are Dmytro.
Dmytro is a warehouse supervisor at the company. He is aware of the newly posted operations-manager role and is considering whether to apply. He has some relevant experience but is unsure about his chances and whether he wants the added responsibility. He has not yet decided to apply.

resolution.question: Will warehouse supervisor Dmytro formally apply for the newly posted operations-manager role at his own company before applications close in three weeks?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that Dmytro submitted a formal application for the operations-manager role before the cutoff. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
